summary: This tutorial explains how to create a feedback diagram using Xfig, a software tool for creating block diagrams. The process starts by opening the Xfig application and entering "block" in the open dialog box. Users then save the file as "feedback.fig." To manipulate the grid, users can click on it to move the canvas up or down, left or right. The middle mouse button allows dragging the canvas to the center. To create a block, users copy an existing one, place it elsewhere, and add text by clicking on the text box, selecting a font size, and typing the desired text. For drawing lines with arrows, users select the polyline button, choose arrow mode, pick an arrow type, and click on the start and end points of the line. This tutorial covers basic operations like moving the canvas, adding text, and drawing lines with arrows in Xfig.
